records.title: test(analysis): TypeScript and Perl false-promotion honesty corpus families
records.release_claim: preview adapters retain explicit non-promotion controls for wrong-owner, token-collision, indirection, unobserved-sink, stale-identity, and dynamic limitations
records.reason: The release narrative explicitly claims cross-language honesty rather than parity. Twenty negative cases plus positive controls prevent both false promotion and disable-all degeneration.
records.non_claim: The corpus does not promote TypeScript or Perl support or establish universal false-positive rates.

records.title: fix(analysis): guard function-owner calls against owner-module mocks
records.release_claim: a test that replaces the changed owner's module cannot receive strong direct/imported owner-call credit for observing the real changed sink
records.reason: The Function/ArrowFunction path lacked the mock guard already used by other owner kinds and could upgrade a mocked exact assertion to exposed evidence.
records.non_claim: Unresolved or mocked relations remain limited rather than being credited through name/path proximity.

records.title: fix(output): label discriminator evidence by state and name the real preview limitation
records.release_claim: observed advisory discriminator evidence is not rendered as missing, and preview-limited next actions name whether the blocker is advisory authority, a static limitation, or incomplete route fields
records.reason: Contradictory labels and generic preview advice make the selected packet-authority and support-boundary claims misleading. Thirty-seven fixture goldens pin the corrected states.
records.non_claim: A complete preview packet remains advisory and cannot acquire gate, badge, baseline, or RIPR Zero authority.

records.title: feat(cli): support worktree diff sources in check-artifact reuse
records.release_claim: an explicit reusable check artifact may represent a base-to-live-worktree diff and fails closed when dirty or advanced worktree bytes no longer match
records.reason: This is a coherent extension of #2208/#2250. It should ship only if the check-artifact feature group is selected; otherwise the design, implementation, and worktree extension defer together.
records.non_claim: Unsaved editor buffers are not included, and the additive variant does not turn ordinary check JSON into a reusable artifact.

records.title: harden(annotations): replace exists-then-read with one direct read
records.release_claim: optional review-comment input distinguishes NotFound from permission, directory, encoding, and other I/O failures without a time-of-check/time-of-use race
records.reason: The generated-CI and annotation path must fail closed on real read errors instead of treating a pre-check result as authority. Source-scan tests guard realistic reintroduction forms.
records.non_claim: Valid and genuinely missing optional inputs preserve their prior external behavior.
